victims.description: superscale.com SuperScale is a Slovak game growth platform founded in 2015 in Bratislava, helping over 500 mobile game studios scale their games through AI-powered performance marketing, data science and monetization optimization. With around 60 employees and 1000 plus games grown, it offers both a SaaS platform and managed growth services acting as an outsourced UA and live ops team. Its core technology includes predictive LTV and retention models, automated user acquisition campaigns and AI creative production across Facebook, Google, TikTok and Apple Search Ads. Led by CEO Ivan Trancik, the company specializes in hybrid monetization strategies combining ads, in-app purchases and subscriptions for casual, midcore and hypercasual titles.

rexvilleradiology.com Rexville Radiology is a diagnostic imaging center in Bayamón, Puerto Rico, founded by neuro-radiology specialist Dr. Ramón Pizarro Fornaris and accredited by the American College of Radiology. It offers a full range of imaging services under one roof including open MRI, 64-slice CT scanning, 3D digital mammography with tomosynthesis, ultrasound, DEXA bone density and digital X-ray. The center stands out for its open MRI design that accommodates claustrophobic patients and its advanced breast imaging with 3D tomosynthesis for early cancer detection. Led by Dr. Pizarro, a recognized neuro-radiologist, it provides personalized care with fast turnaround times and early opening hours from 6 AM six days a week.

gbl-trier.de Grundbaulabor Trier is a German geotechnical engineering firm founded in 1960 in Trier by Dr. Paul Lehmann, now run by the third generation of the Lehmann family with 23 qualified engineers. It has completed over 20,000 projects in soil investigation, foundation design, construction supervision, environmental contamination assessment and hydrogeology across Rhineland-Palatinate, Saarland and Luxembourg. The firm operates its own soil mechanics laboratory offering fast and reliable sample processing with modern testing equipment. Led by Managing Directors Eric Lehmann and Bernd Mertes, it is one of the leading geotechnical bureaus in the Trier-Saarbrücken-Luxembourg region.

immovia-hausverwaltung.de ImmoVia Hausverwaltung GmbH is a German property management company registered in November 2025 in Bautzen, Saxony, founded by property owners who bring their own landlord experience to managing rental properties and condominium associations. Led by Managing Director Ramona Biehle with equal shareholders holding 33.3 percent each, the firm offers rental management, WEG administration, technical building management and DATEV-compatible tax data integration. Its philosophy is reliable, solution-oriented and personal management treating each property as if it were its own.

The facility is dedicated to ensuring a safe, secure, and homelike environment, focusing on the physical, emotional, and spiritual well-being of its residents. Recognized as a premier memory care community, Regency Park Oak Knoll is committed to treating every resident like family.

eichstaett.de 1,5 tb information Eichstätt is a small historic town in Upper Bavaria with 13,500 inhabitants and 1400 years of history, famous for its baroque architecture, Jura Museum with Archaeopteryx fossils and UNESCO Altmühltal Geopark. The Katholische Universität Eichstätt-Ingolstadt enrolls about 4,800 students across 4 faculties spanning theology, philosophy, languages and business in Ingolstadt. Under President Dr. Klaus Stüwe since 2023, it received 5.86 million euro in Bavarian funding for digital transformation and AI programs. It is developing an international campus in Shandong, China and launching new sustainability master's degrees. Key strengths are its Catholic identity, small class sizes and strategic location between Munich and Nuremberg.

fptsoftware.com FPT Software is the largest IT services company in Southeast Asia, founded in 1999 in Hanoi with 1.34 billion dollars in revenue and over 33,000 employees across 31 countries. It serves 1,100 clients including 130 Fortune Global 500 companies across automotive, banking, healthcare and energy, with Japan as its largest international market. Its AI-first strategy uses the FleziPT platform delivering 30 percent productivity gains, with AI and data services growing 60 percent in 2026. In 2025 it signed a record 256 million dollar AI transformation deal and secured 26 projects above 10 million dollars. Strategic partnerships span NVIDIA, Microsoft, SAP, AWS and OpenAI. Key strengths are unmatched scale from Vietnam, deep AI capabilities and a 152,000 strong education talent pipeline.

myfirstdental.com First Dental Care is a dental practice network in Massachusetts founded by Dr. Farshad Ghobbeh, who opened his first clinic in Medford in 2008 and expanded to Somerville in 2012 and four more locations including Arlington, Watertown, Acton and Bedford. With over 20,000 patients and 18 years of experience, it offers general and cosmetic dentistry, dental implants, Invisalign, emergency care and smile makeovers across six clinics. Its Smile Now Pay Later model with Klarna makes implants available from 58 dollars per month and whitening at 149 dollars instead of 500. The team is multilingual speaking English, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese and Persian to serve diverse Massachusetts communities. It accepts over 15 insurance plans including Aetna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, Delta Dental and MassHealth. Key strengths are 18 years of community trust, multi-location accessibility, affordable payment plans and Dr. Ghobbeh's personal commitment to quality oral health.

angelescontractor.com Angeles Contractor Inc is a general contractor founded in 1998 in City of Industry, California, with 8 CSLB license categories and 63 to 95 employees delivering construction projects across Southern California. It has completed 259 public works projects worth over 197 million dollars for 47 government agencies, led by San Bernardino County with 73 contracts. Its portfolio includes the Rose Bowl renovation, UCLA dining hall, CGV Cinemas, Paakuma K-8 School and a 14.5 million dollar Big Bear Airport terminal rebuild. Led by President Young W. Kang and VP Alex Cho, it maintains over 90 percent repeat business across education, healthcare, commercial and residential sectors. It holds multiple JOC contracts with San Bernardino, San Mateo and Sourcewell worth up to 30 million dollars per year. The company is a certified Minority Business Enterprise with active expansion into Northern California through offices in San Jose and Salinas.

svedala.se Revenue $282.1 Million Svedala kommun is a municipality in Skåne County, Sweden, part of Greater Malmö with 23,722 residents and a projected growth to 26,800 by 2032. It jumped from 63rd to 15th place in Sweden's Bäst att leva 2026 ranking, ranking number one nationwide in business climate, self-sufficiency and outbound commuting. The local economy centers on transport and warehousing driven by Malmö Airport, with Sandvik SRP as the largest private employer and a new Airport City MMX business park planned to create 1,000 jobs. The municipality runs a balanced budget of SEK 1.66 billion with a tax rate below the national average. Education performs above average with 89.8 percent gymnasium eligibility and 80.3 percent qualified teachers. It is investing 431 million kronor in infrastructure 2025 to 2027.

skcapitalpartners.com Revenue $63 Million SK Capital Partners is a New York-based private equity firm founded in 2007 as a spinoff from Apax Partners, managing approximately 10 billion dollars across 60 plus investments in specialty chemicals, pharmaceuticals and ingredients. Led by co-founder Barry Siadat, it targets control investments in companies with 100 million to 1 billion dollars in revenue and has built platforms like Advansix, Sartomer and Cura Particles through buy-and-build strategies. Its portfolio companies employ over 12,000 people and generate more than 5 billion dollars in annual revenue. Recent deals include the July 2026 acquisition of Lorama Group and the October 2026 purchase of Vesuvius Americas refractory assets. Key strengths are deep sector expertise in real-economy industrial businesses and proven IPO and trade sale exits.

cbh.com Revenue $446.7 Million CBH Group Australia's largest grain cooperative, founded in 1933 in Perth and owned by over 3,700 farmer shareholders across Western Australia. It operates the world's largest grain export network with around 200 receival sites, 20 million tons of storage capacity and four export terminals at Kwinana, Albany, Geraldton and Esperance. Each year it handles approximately 20 million tons of grain and exports 15 to 17 million tons, mainly wheat, barley and canola to Asia, the Middle East and beyond. Led by CEO Brendan White, it has invested over 2 billion dollars in infrastructure modernization including rail upgrades, solar energy and digital platforms like the CBH App. The cooperative is financially strong with a BBB credit rating and returns profits to farmers through patronage dividends. It operates its own rail fleet of 360 wagons, runs quality testing laboratories at every site and is expanding port capacity to load Panamax vessels at Kwinana and Albany.

giodentalsl.com GIO Dental SL is a modern dental clinic and laboratory founded by Nigerian dentist Dr. Gift Nwachukwu Obiorah in Freetown, Sierra Leone, with an additional location in Koidu, Kono District. It is Sierra Leone's first fully integrated dental provider offering clinical treatment, a prosthetics laboratory, dental technology education and equipment repair under one brand. Services span general and cosmetic dentistry, orthodontics, oral surgery, custom prosthetics fabrication and community oral health programs. Led by founder Dr. Gio, the company trains local dental technicians and runs outreach campaigns to make premium dental care accessible across the country. Its vertical model combining treatment, manufacturing and education is unique in the Sierra Leonean healthcare market. It also provides equipment repair and supply services to other dental clinics in the region.

commtank.com CommTank Inc is a US storage tank contractor founded in 1997 in Winchester, Massachusetts, specializing in installation, removal, inspection and maintenance of underground and aboveground storage tanks across New England and the Mid-Atlantic. With 50 to 100 employees and estimated revenue of 10 to 25 million dollars, it serves government facilities, hospitals, schools and industrial clients across 8 states. Its services cover the full tank lifecycle including UST and AST installation, leak testing, cathodic protection, soil remediation and emergency spill response. Led by founder Rick Connolly, it holds EPA, MA DEP, CT DEEP and NFPA certifications and runs its own field crews without subcontracting core work. It also provides Phase I and II environmental site assessments and SPCC compliance planning. The company has built a niche in high-barrier tank services requiring specialized licensing and regulatory expertise.

ined.fr INED is France's National Institute for Demographic Studies, founded in 1945 in Paris as a public scientific research institution under CNRS patronage and the world's largest demographic research center with 200 staff and 120 researchers. It holds a unique mandate as France's national population statistics authority, producing the annual Démographie de la France report and the monthly Population and Sociétés bulletin. Its 8 research departments cover mortality, fertility, migration, social stratification and global health, publishing over 300 scientific papers per year. INED maintains 20 plus demographic databases including the global Human Fertility and Human Mortality Databases with Max Planck and UC Berkeley. Led by Director Cyrille Schott, it partners with the UN, WHO and 50 plus international institutions while offering open access to all publications.

novadata.com.ar NOVADATA S.A. is an Argentine IT integration group founded in 1994 in Buenos Aires, comprising Novadata, Net Service and Compañía Global de Servicios with 130 plus certified professionals. It provides IT infrastructure, business continuity, AI, pay-per-use HPE GreenLake, microinformatics and 24/7 Service Desk services to major corporations across Argentina. It holds HPE Platinum, Microsoft Gold, Cisco Silver, VMware Enterprise and Symantec Gold partner certifications, adding Huawei Enterprise Authorized Reseller status in 2026. Major clients include Bayer, Veolia, La Anónima, Petrobras, Citibank, Roche and Bimbo, many with over 10 years of partnership. The group completed a financial restructuring agreement from 2014, declared fulfilled by court in March 2026. Recent strategic moves include an AI alliance with AYI Group, Fortinet cybersecurity training and launch of Novadata GREEN IT asset disposition services.

Revenue isn't reliably public — broker estimates range wildly from ~$10M to $50M, but a TaiPEX filing suggests ~$5M+/month after consolidation. Certifications (ISO 9001, ISO 13485, IATF 16949) support real OEM work (e.g. Teleflex via a 3D Systems case)
